package.name: dual_arm_transport_mock
package.description:
C4.3 S3: minimal offline dual-arm coordinated transport under a FIXED grasp relation (no re-grasping, no handover inside the segment).
Scope (C4.3_S3_实施方案.md): - The object task that the C2 QP has always had but never used is finally driven from an ANCHORED object frame T_hat(q_L) = T_WL(q_L) * G_L^-1. The legacy midpoint estimate is never used for the object task. - The expected object trajectory is precomputed and FROZEN (yaml), with a velocity feed-forward; the closed loop only tracks it. - Every control cycle is TWO-PHASE: compute a candidate q_cand, run the per-cycle and swept collision checks on the CANDIDATE configuration and object placement, and only then commit. A rejected cycle is recorded as committed=false and is never counted as executed. - Three independent object-pose sources (left anchor / right anchor / desired) are all reported every cycle.
This package is deliberately SEPARATE from dual_arm_transport (S2) because S2 is a frozen deliverable: S3 must not widen its build surface (it would need a new dual_arm_qp_core dependency). S2 artifacts (transport_baseline.yaml, grasp geometry) are consumed through its PUBLIC interface, never copied.
Non-goals: no Gazebo, no hardware, no re-planning, no re-grasping, no modification of the S2 frozen baseline, no refactor of the C2 algorithms.
